items.text: Bilimgoh's English course completely changed everything for me. I scored 8.0 on IELTS and got admitted to Westminster Tashkent. The mentors are truly passionate about teaching.

items.name: Feruza Abdullayeva
items.text: I finished the UX design course and now I work at Uzum. Sevinch opa is an amazing mentor — she gave personal feedback on every project.

items.name: Bekzod Tursunov
items.text: The marketing course helped me grow my startup. It was the best investment in my education — I'm planning new projects right now.
